cn.description:
死亡并非永眠。

操作炼金实验失败的产物，在杀戮与重生的反复轮回中探索一座房间不断变化的巨大城堡，解开这座阴暗孤岛上的秘密…!
当然，前提是你能战胜镇守其中的诸多守卫。

重生细胞是一款RogueVania类型的平台动作游戏。你需要在一次一次战斗中锤炼战斗技巧，精通拥有独特使用方式的各种武器，并且将翻滚和闪避等走位操作视为本能，以逃过那些出其不意出现的怪潮侵袭，迎战强横凶残的守卫和Boss。

鏖战、死亡、重生、再战

继PC与主机平台之后，《重生细胞》准备在移动平台开启战斗！

【主要特色】
• RogueVania: 逐步攻略经过悉心设计的相连关卡，体验rogue-lite类型的重复可玩性，直面肾上腺素激增的凶险场面。
• 凌厉爽快的2D动作体验：洞悉敌人的出手套路灵活走位，否则你将止步于半途，无缘城堡中隐藏的更多秘密。
• 非线性进程：在反复的死亡中突破难关，根据自己的游玩风格或心情自由选择装备与技能搭配。厌倦了臭气熏天的下水道？攀上城头呼吸新鲜的空气吧！
• 随心所欲的游玩：探索城堡的边边角角和隐秘通道，发现深藏在城堡深处的迷人景观，抑或是直冲终点？一切由你。

【针对移动平台进行的悉心优化】
• 两种攻击模式：传统与移动版新加入的自动攻击系统。
• 定制键位与触屏操作：根据你的喜好调整按钮位置及大小，通过触屏滑动来进行闪避走位…
• MFi设备以及主机控制器蓝牙连接特性支持。

经典三国单机版

《逐鹿》是一款基于同名历史沙盘游戏引擎开发而成的三国题材回合制策略游戏。在硝烟四起、诸侯争霸的三国乱世中，玩家可以在剧本中任意选择势力，饰演主公。通过内政、外交等玩法助你运筹帷幄。带领麾下群雄，攻城略地，在辽阔的战场上开疆扩土。或兴复汉室，或成一代枭雄，皆掌握在你的手中。

问鼎九州，逐鹿三国

《逐鹿》的历史剧本以《三国演义》为蓝本推演而来，游戏贯穿历史典故，力求还原三国时期的史实风貌。玩家可以任意挑选剧本，并饰演其中一势力的主公，谋定三国，一统九州。

山河为子，天下为局

《逐鹿》以经典六角战棋玩法为核心战斗模式，玩家可以指挥部队以“六角战棋”的形式纵横驰骋于大战场之上，或与敌人短兵相接，或以计谋决胜千里之外，在矢石之间，开疆扩土。

坚甲利兵，攻无不克

在游戏中兵种可分为步兵、骑兵、机械三大类，细分则有弓兵、弩兵、盾兵、轻骑兵等十余种。还有数十种专属兵种可以携带，出征时根据战况调配兵种阵容，能够达到先发制人，克敌机先的效果。

鸾翔凤集，龙幡虎纛

根据历史文献记载以及结合三国演义内容，目前游戏中已设计武将有600余名。每个武将具有独特的特性，可以凸显武将的差异化。不仅如此，我们还为历史名将绘制了精致的专属立绘，彰显其个性。

cn.description:
死亡并非永眠。

操作炼金实验失败的产物，在杀戮与重生的反复轮回中探索一座房间不断变化的巨大城堡，解开这座阴暗孤岛上的秘密…!
当然，前提是你能战胜镇守其中的诸多守卫。

重生细胞是一款RogueVania类型的平台动作游戏。你需要在一次一次战斗中锤炼战斗技巧，精通拥有独特使用方式的各种武器，并且将翻滚和闪避等走位操作视为本能，以逃过那些出其不意出现的怪潮侵袭，迎战强横凶残的守卫和Boss。

鏖战、死亡、重生、再战

继PC与主机平台之后，《重生细胞》准备在移动平台开启战斗！

【主要特色】
• RogueVania: 逐步攻略经过悉心设计的相连关卡，体验rogue-lite类型的重复可玩性，直面肾上腺素激增的凶险场面。
• 凌厉爽快的2D动作体验：洞悉敌人的出手套路灵活走位，否则你将止步于半途，无缘城堡中隐藏的更多秘密。
• 非线性进程：在反复的死亡中突破难关，根据自己的游玩风格或心情自由选择装备与技能搭配。厌倦了臭气熏天的下水道？攀上城头呼吸新鲜的空气吧！
• 随心所欲的游玩：探索城堡的边边角角和隐秘通道，发现深藏在城堡深处的迷人景观，抑或是直冲终点？一切由你。

【针对移动平台进行的悉心优化】
• 两种攻击模式：传统与移动版新加入的自动攻击系统。
• 定制键位与触屏操作：根据你的喜好调整按钮位置及大小，通过触屏滑动来进行闪避走位…
• MFi设备以及主机控制器蓝牙连接特性支持。

《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

hk.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported.

Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.

– Kaylee

New version of the multi-awarded board game. Now in 3D. Includes improved AI, 3D landscape, new exclusive features.

*** Carcassonne fits that opening game niche that every game group needs. -Tyler Nichols, Board Game Quest
*** Carcassonne = Great game, great mechanics, great pieces, great fun! -The Board Game Family

A TILE PLACEMENT GAME OF CREATING LANDSCAPES, CLAIMING AREAS, AND GAINING POINTS
Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... Each meeple will help you control your territory and win points.
But be careful, you will need all your best strategy and tactics to maximum your points! Place your tiles and your meeples wisely to stop your opponents and win the game.

6 EXPANSIONS: ENLARGE YOUR LANDSCAPE AND OPTIMIZE YOUR POINTS
Thanks to the mini expansions ""The River"" and ""The Abbot"", you can embellish your landscape and vary your game to enjoy new ways to play! Double or even triple your points thanks to the new buildings in the Inns & Cathedrals expansion! And with the Traders & Builders expansion, score more points with the trading commodities and build faster with the builders! Discover the city of Carcassonne covered with a blanket of white snow in the Winter Edition... and look out for the Gingerbread Man and the bonus points he'll give you! Beware of the Dragon in ""the Princess and the Dragon"" expansion! He could eat your Meeples if you're not cautious. And be kind with the Princess: she might prefer you to other Meeples and toss them out of the cities!

FEATURES
• Accessible and tactical gameplay adapted from the award-winning Carcassonne board game    
• 6 expansions:
- The River, the Inns & Cathedrals, the Traders & Builders, the Winter Edition and Princess & Dragon are all available to purchase from the Game Shop.
- Unlock The Abbot for free using your Asmodee account.
• Up to 6 players! Play against the computer in solo mode, face off your friends in Pass and Play or challenge players from around the world in online mode
• There is no more 3 but 4 different behaviors you can chose before starting a game with AIs. They all propose a better challenge than the previous ones. Players who want to experiment a true challenge will play against the Conqueror AI who is the strongest AI of the game.
• Try out the aerial top view to refine your strategy!
• Additional strategic layers compared to the physical version:
- field view which allows you to see the field possession of each player
- remaining tile list: allows you to see the tiles which are remaining in the draw pile

hk.description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

《獵人征途》的野生動物外型真實而美麗，且具備符合現實的動物群體行為特徵，提供玩家全面且真實的狩獵體驗，讓人能完全沉浸在遊戲世界。親眼目睹複雜多樣的生態環境產生的變化，周遭環境會因為你的行動而出現變動及反應。瞭解真正的獵人所代表的意義，並充分運用自己的技能來戰勝考驗。

面對人道狩獵的挑戰、搭配引人入勝的故事情節進行遊戲，或是單純地在這富饒的自然環境中自由狩獵。

靠窗還是靠走道？吧台還是桌子？獨自坐在角落，還是成為聚會的風雲人物？在《這位子形不形？》的世界，你需要依照大家的喜好安排位子。這款邏輯益智遊戲氛圍輕鬆、毫無壓力，誰待在哪裡，全由你來決定。

控制香料，就是控制宇宙。
厄拉科斯、沙丘、沙漠星球。在面前的广袤荒原上高举你的旗帜。当立法会各大家族调集军队和间谍时，你将影响谁，又将背叛谁？暴虐的皇帝、神秘的贝尼·杰瑟里特、精明的宇航公会、沙漠深处凶残的弗雷曼人。帝国的力量可以属于你，但战争并不是夺取力量的唯一途径。
《沙丘：帝国》是一款主题鲜明的全新战略游戏，融合了牌组搭建和工人放置的元素，将帝国的命运掌握在你手中。你会寻求政治盟友还是依靠军事力量？靠经济实力还是耍阴谋诡计？让议会席位决定……还是亮出锋利的刀刃？拿好手牌，决定在你手中，帝国正在等待。

hk.description:
在这款备受赞誉的策略桌游中，规划并建设一座科学管理的现代化动物园，为保护项目提供支持。

你将在《Ark Nova》中规划和设计一座科学管理的现代化动物园。并向着“拥有最成功的动物园”的终极目标努力奋斗。你将建造饲养区、容纳动物并支持世界各地的保护项目，专家们和各种独特建筑将帮助你实现这一目标。

《Ark Nova》的核心要素是 255 张以动物、专家、独特饲养区与保护项目为主题的卡牌。每张卡牌都拥有特定能力，你可以利用它们来提高动物园的魅力和科学声望并收集保护点数。每位玩家都有一组行动卡牌，你可以通过使用和升级这些卡牌来实施你的计划。

每位玩家都可以使用一套五张行动卡牌来进行游戏，行动的强度由卡牌当前占据的槽位决定。这些卡牌是：

建造：允许你建造标准/特殊饲养区、贩售亭与休憩亭。

动物：允许你在自己的动物园中容纳动物。

卡牌：允许你获得新动物园卡牌（动物、赞助商以及保护项目卡牌）。

协会：允许你的协会事务员完成不同任务。

赞助商：允许你在自己的动物园中打出一张赞助商卡牌或获得钱币。

《Ark Nova》拥有极高的可玩性和丰富的组件，可提供不同凡响的游戏体验，让玩家无数次体验游戏的乐趣。

Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

hk.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

hk.description:
Dolores, Ted, Mary Jane and Timmy return to face the nuclear apocalypse in this new, remastered edition of the classic atomic adventure - 60 Seconds! Reatomized, featuring high resolution art support, refreshed 2D graphics and hand-drawn 3D textures, new interactive menu, improved UI system, a technical refresh, and of course... new content!

NEW GAMEPLAY MODE
Survival Challenges - unique, short storylines which will put your survival skills to the test!

NEW OPPORTUNITIES
to escape the wasteland in form of a storyline spanning across multiple playthroughs! Can you escape the wasteland in style?

NEW RELATIONSHIP SYSTEM
more stories and crazy interactions between the McDoodle family members!

NEW SOUNDS, ART AND UNLOCKABLE VISUAL CONTENT
allowing you to add a little color to your fallout shelter!

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS!

With only 60 seconds left to impact, go on a mad dash through the house in search of family members and useful supplies. Everything will be against you: time, your very own furniture, a house that's different every time you play, and the fundamental question... what to take with you and who to leave behind?

Reaching the fallout shelter in time, alive, is only the beginning. Whatever you scavenged and whoever you saved will play a vital role in your survival. Each survival story will be different, with every day surprising you with unexpected events. Will all of these stories end well? It's up to you. Ration food and water, make best use of your supplies, face difficult choices and even venture into the wasteland.

Good luck.

mo.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

mo.description:
擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

■ 隨選擇擴展的技能樹
從攻擊力、攻擊速度、特殊能力等方向中，選擇自己想要的成長路線。
優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

■ 不斷變強的武器
武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

遊戲特色
- 越戰越強的增量式成長
- 透過收集資源與反覆強化提升火力
- 隨選擇變化的技能樹
- 運用卡牌和遺物搭配流派
- 個性十足的異次元傭兵
- 閃電、冰凍、隕石、迴旋鏢等多種能力
- 可持續強化的武器

- 鋪滿畫面的史萊姆與爽快打擊感

You find yourself in rustic, pre-modern Tuscany, where you’ve inherited a meager vineyard. You own a few plots of land, an old crush pad, a tiny cellar, 3 workers…and the dream of owning the best winery in Italy.

Your job is to allocate your workers and helpful visitors to complete various tasks throughout the year. New version of the multi-awarded board game. Now in 3D. Includes improved AI, 3D landscape, new exclusive features.

*** Carcassonne fits that opening game niche that every game group needs. -Tyler Nichols, Board Game Quest
*** Carcassonne = Great game, great mechanics, great pieces, great fun! -The Board Game Family

A TILE PLACEMENT GAME OF CREATING LANDSCAPES, CLAIMING AREAS, AND GAINING POINTS
Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... Each meeple will help you control your territory and win points.
But be careful, you will need all your best strategy and tactics to maximum your points! Place your tiles and your meeples wisely to stop your opponents and win the game.

6 EXPANSIONS: ENLARGE YOUR LANDSCAPE AND OPTIMIZE YOUR POINTS
Thanks to the mini expansions ""The River"" and ""The Abbot"", you can embellish your landscape and vary your game to enjoy new ways to play! Double or even triple your points thanks to the new buildings in the Inns & Cathedrals expansion! And with the Traders & Builders expansion, score more points with the trading commodities and build faster with the builders! Discover the city of Carcassonne covered with a blanket of white snow in the Winter Edition... and look out for the Gingerbread Man and the bonus points he'll give you! Beware of the Dragon in ""the Princess and the Dragon"" expansion! He could eat your Meeples if you're not cautious. And be kind with the Princess: she might prefer you to other Meeples and toss them out of the cities!

• Accessible and tactical gameplay adapted from the award-winning Carcassonne board game    
• 6 expansions:
- The River, the Inns & Cathedrals, the Traders & Builders, the Winter Edition and Princess & Dragon are all available to purchase from the Game Shop.

- field view which allows you to see the field possession of each player

Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.

《Way of the Hunter》將推出手機端系列首作，太平洋西北地區的壯美景觀隨之鋪陳眼前。

在美國內茲珀斯谷的廣闊開放世界中，體驗最真實的狩獵與探索。在风景如画的自然栖息地中发现栩栩如生的动物，使用各种细节逼真的武器。

mo.description:
靠窗還是靠走道？吧台還是桌子？獨自坐在角落，還是成為聚會的風雲人物？在《這位子形不形？》的世界，你需要依照大家的喜好安排位子。這款邏輯益智遊戲氛圍輕鬆、毫無壓力，誰待在哪裡，全由你來決定。

電影院、擁擠公車、婚宴、窄小計程車，每個場景都會引入具有特定偏好的新角色。聚會上有些客人鼻子很靈，不願意坐在噴了太多古龍水的陌生人旁邊。公車上有些乘客想小睡片刻，不希望旁邊有人大聲播放音樂。仔細觀察現場的所有角色，設法安排最合適的位子！

一心想進入影劇圈發展的納特，在大銀幕上看到跟自己一模一樣的演員之後，生活發生了翻天覆地的變化。納特就此踏上全球之旅，就是為了認識那個主角，還有設法在理想中找到容身之處。跟隨納特的腳步走過一座座城市，感受其心路歷程，並體驗不同的關卡、角色和魅力。

- 為各有偏好的角色安排合適位子。
- 探索角色各不相同的特點，有的似曾相識，有的莫名其妙，有的則介於兩者之間。
- 沒有計時，也沒有排行榜，只要輕鬆享受解謎的成就感。

We’ve added a Reputation system! We’ve heard your feedback about players leaving games early, which can be disappointing for everyone involved. Rep rewards players for completing online games and gives you a way to filter for more committed opponents.

Players will start with 30 Reputation. You’ll gain Rep for completing games and lose Rep for leaving games early. You never need to win to gain Rep, just finish. When creating an online lobby, you can set a minimum Rep requirement to join (no greater than your own Rep). Players must maintain more than 0 Rep to play Ranked.

mo.description:
让自己沉浸在《沙丘》的世界中。
在屡获殊荣的棋盘游戏《沙丘：帝国》中，穿梭于地形险恶的厄拉科斯星球，体验策略与阴谋的终极融合！
"在线对战、与人工智能进行本地对战，或与强大的哈葛尔家族对战。
获得成就，展示你作为领袖的实力。
面对十数种挑战，考验你的智慧和狡黠。
在轮换的遭遇战模式中争夺徽章，每场比赛都不尽相同！"
控制香料，就是控制宇宙。
厄拉科斯、沙丘、沙漠星球。在面前的广袤荒原上高举你的旗帜。当立法会各大家族调集军队和间谍时，你将影响谁，又将背叛谁？暴虐的皇帝、神秘的贝尼·杰瑟里特、精明的宇航公会、沙漠深处凶残的弗雷曼人。帝国的力量可以属于你，但战争并不是夺取力量的唯一途径。
《沙丘：帝国》是一款主题鲜明的全新战略游戏，融合了牌组搭建和工人放置的元素，将帝国的命运掌握在你手中。你会寻求政治盟友还是依靠军事力量？靠经济实力还是耍阴谋诡计？让议会席位决定……还是亮出锋利的刀刃？拿好手牌，决定在你手中，帝国正在等待。

mo.description:
在这款备受赞誉的策略桌游中，规划并建设一座科学管理的现代化动物园，为保护项目提供支持。

你将在《Ark Nova》中规划和设计一座科学管理的现代化动物园。并向着“拥有最成功的动物园”的终极目标努力奋斗。你将建造饲养区、容纳动物并支持世界各地的保护项目，专家们和各种独特建筑将帮助你实现这一目标。

《Ark Nova》的核心要素是 255 张以动物、专家、独特饲养区与保护项目为主题的卡牌。每张卡牌都拥有特定能力，你可以利用它们来提高动物园的魅力和科学声望并收集保护点数。每位玩家都有一组行动卡牌，你可以通过使用和升级这些卡牌来实施你的计划。

每位玩家都可以使用一套五张行动卡牌来进行游戏，行动的强度由卡牌当前占据的槽位决定。这些卡牌是：

建造：允许你建造标准/特殊饲养区、贩售亭与休憩亭。

动物：允许你在自己的动物园中容纳动物。

卡牌：允许你获得新动物园卡牌（动物、赞助商以及保护项目卡牌）。

协会：允许你的协会事务员完成不同任务。

赞助商：允许你在自己的动物园中打出一张赞助商卡牌或获得钱币。

《Ark Nova》拥有极高的可玩性和丰富的组件，可提供不同凡响的游戏体验，让玩家无数次体验游戏的乐趣。

Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

mo.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

to escape the wasteland in form of a storyline spanning across multiple playthroughs! Can you escape the wasteland in style?

more stories and crazy interactions between the McDoodle family members!

allowing you to add a little color to your fallout shelter!

tw.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported.

Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.

tw.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

New version of the multi-awarded board game. Now in 3D. Includes improved AI, 3D landscape, new exclusive features.

*** Carcassonne fits that opening game niche that every game group needs. -Tyler Nichols, Board Game Quest
*** Carcassonne = Great game, great mechanics, great pieces, great fun! -The Board Game Family

A TILE PLACEMENT GAME OF CREATING LANDSCAPES, CLAIMING AREAS, AND GAINING POINTS
Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... Each meeple will help you control your territory and win points.
But be careful, you will need all your best strategy and tactics to maximum your points! Place your tiles and your meeples wisely to stop your opponents and win the game.

Double or even triple your points thanks to the new buildings in the Inns & Cathedrals expansion! And with the Traders & Builders expansion, score more points with the trading commodities and build faster with the builders! Discover the city of Carcassonne covered with a blanket of white snow in the Winter Edition... and look out for the Gingerbread Man and the bonus points he'll give you! tw.description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

tw.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

us.description:
Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere.

TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO
• Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards
• Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers
• One roster — switch freely; progress, items and wallet are shared

FIVE CLASSES
• Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive
• Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power
• Witcher — swift blood-clan marksman with precision shots and paralyzing arrows
• Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows
• Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks

A CONTINENT TO CONQUER
Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner.

DUNGEONS & BOSSES
Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns.

THREE RISK MODES
• Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning
• Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP
• Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP

LIFE SKILLS & GEAR
Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power.

TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS
Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear.

DAILY REWARDS
Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding.

NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES
English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia.

The same account works on iOS and Android — progress is never lost. Premium game: pay once, no ads. Optional in-app purchases (diamonds, membership) available.

us.description:
Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs
- Weapons that can be continuously upgraded
- Cute 2D pixel art
- Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact

You find yourself in rustic, pre-modern Tuscany, where you’ve inherited a meager vineyard. You own a few plots of land, an old crush pad, a tiny cellar, 3 workers…and the dream of owning the best winery in Italy.

Your job is to allocate your workers and helpful visitors to complete various tasks throughout the year. Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... us.description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. 

At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans.

Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are:

BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions.

ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo.

CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards).

ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks.

SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money.

With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

us.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere.

TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO
• Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards
• Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers

FIVE CLASSES
• Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive
• Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power

• Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows
• Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks

A CONTINENT TO CONQUER
Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner.

DUNGEONS & BOSSES
Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns.

THREE RISK MODES
• Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning
• Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP
• Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP

LIFE SKILLS & GEAR
Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power.

TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS
Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear.

DAILY REWARDS
Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding.

NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES
English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia.

tr.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... tr.description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE

- No ads, no microtransactions.

Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. 

At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans.

Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are:

BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions.

ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo.

CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards).

ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks.

SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money.

With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

Dolores, Ted, Mary Jane and Timmy return to face the nuclear apocalypse in this new, remastered edition of the classic atomic adventure - 60 Seconds! Reatomized, featuring high resolution art support, refreshed 2D graphics and hand-drawn 3D textures, new interactive menu, improved UI system, a technical refresh, and of course... new content!

NEW GAMEPLAY MODE
Survival Challenges - unique, short storylines which will put your survival skills to the test!

NEW OPPORTUNITIES
to escape the wasteland in form of a storyline spanning across multiple playthroughs! Can you escape the wasteland in style?

NEW RELATIONSHIP SYSTEM
more stories and crazy interactions between the McDoodle family members!

NEW SOUNDS, ART AND UNLOCKABLE VISUAL CONTENT
allowing you to add a little color to your fallout shelter!

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS!

With only 60 seconds left to impact, go on a mad dash through the house in search of family members and useful supplies. Everything will be against you: time, your very own furniture, a house that's different every time you play, and the fundamental question... what to take with you and who to leave behind?

Reaching the fallout shelter in time, alive, is only the beginning. Whatever you scavenged and whoever you saved will play a vital role in your survival. Each survival story will be different, with every day surprising you with unexpected events. Will all of these stories end well? It's up to you. pt.description:
Guardian OL2 é um MMORPG de ação 3D em estilo retrô onde um só herói vive em dois mundos. Aventure-se online com jogadores reais ou explore seu Mundo Solo privado no seu ritmo — seu personagem, equipamento e diamantes acompanham você em tudo.

DOIS MUNDOS, UM HERÓI
• Mundo Multiplayer — um reino online vivo: masmorras em equipe, comércio na casa de leilões, rankings
• Mundo Solo — uma cópia privada do continente no seu ritmo: sem filas, sem competição, só você e seus seguidores
• Uma só lista — troque quando quiser; progresso, itens e carteira compartilhados

CINCO CLASSES
• Templário — cavaleiro sagrado cujas curas e bênçãos mantêm o grupo vivo
• Mago — frágil, mas devastador mestre do fogo, gelo e arcano
• Bruxo — atirador veloz do clã do sangue: tiros precisos e flechas paralisantes
• Grande Espada Guerreira — baluarte de sangue titânico: provocações, muralhas de escudos e golpes esmagadores
• Berserker — anão devoto do fogo que ceifa as fileiras inimigas em fúria giratória

UM CONTINENTE A CONQUISTAR
Siga a história própria da sua classe por aldeias, tundras congeladas, cavernas de aranhas e criptas assombradas até Grand Village, a cidade-base onde a verdadeira caça começa. Missões, elites e drops do mundo em cada canto.

MASMORRAS E CHEFES
Enfrente a cova do lobo, o Ninho de aranha, o covil orc e o Cofre escuro. Cada chefe — o rei lobo sanguinário, o Dragão Vermelho, abrak a aranha, o Rei Esqueleto Leon, o Rei Demônio Naros — traz seu truque: invocações, congelamento, veneno, atordoamento.

TRÊS MODOS DE RISCO
• Normal — sem penalidade de morte; perfeito para aprender
• Pesadelo — morrer custa moedas e cristais; loot e XP melhores
• Inferno — penalidades brutais, os melhores drops e PvP em mundo aberto

OFÍCIOS E EQUIPAMENTO
Minere, colete ervas, pesque e cace — depois forje armas, cozinhe pratos com bônus, prepare poções e encante equipamento. Aprimore, encaixe gemas e desmonte o excedente. Pergaminhos de receitas caem no mundo. Conjuntos dão poder extra.

COMÉRCIO, SEGUIDORES E FACÇÕES
Venda seu loot para jogadores reais na casa de leilões. Contrate seguidores — morcegos, dríades, golems, cogumelos — para lutar ao seu lado. Ganhe reputação com cinco facções (Cavaleiros da luz, Legião Titã, Aliança oculta, Fogo de armas, A fonte da vida) e troque por equipamento exclusivo.

RECOMPENSAS DIÁRIAS
Presentes de login, ofertas diárias, baús diários, conquistas e rankings do servidor fazem cada sessão valer a pena.

AGORA EM 18 IDIOMAS
A mesma conta funciona em iOS e Android — o progresso nunca se perde. Jogo premium: pague uma vez, sem anúncios. Compras opcionais no app (diamantes, assinatura) disponíveis.

pt.description:
O Keeps é uma casa para as coisas que tem — e uma resposta honesta ao que cada uma delas lhe custa.

Adicione um item com uma foto, o preço e o dia em que o comprou. O Keeps divide o preço pelos dias em que o tem, para que um casaco que usa todas as semanas e um gadget esquecido numa gaveta deixem de parecer iguais. Veja o custo por dia descer quanto mais tempo mantiver algo, e saiba quando voltará a reduzir para metade.

O QUE TEM, NUM SÓ LUGAR
• Fotos, detalhes de compra, datas de garantia, notas e etiquetas para cada item
• Categorias definidas por si, com os seus próprios ícones e ordem
• Uma coleção que pode pesquisar, filtrar e ordenar pelo que lhe custa

O QUE CUSTA REALMENTE
• Custo por dia, a partir do preço e dos dias de posse
• Custo por utilização — diga ao Keeps com que frequência usa algo, ou registe as utilizações
• Vendeu ou retirou algo? O Keeps conta o que recebeu de volta
• Uma visão geral das suas despesas por mês e categoria

ADICIONE COISAS DA FORMA FÁCIL
• Importe encomendas Amazon, um recibo em PDF ou uma folha de cálculo — com fotos e preços incluídos
• Cole qualquer página de produto e o Keeps lê o nome, o preço e a foto
• Reveja cada compra antes de entrar na coleção; devoluções e duplicados ficam de lado

DÊ-LHE O SEU ESTILO
• Palco: O original mantém-se intacto. Pode mudar como se apresenta ou repor as edições a qualquer momento.
• Pesquise na web uma imagem melhor, sem sair do Keeps

INTELIGENTE, NO SEU DISPOSITIVO
• Descreva um item e receba uma sugestão de nome, categoria e etiquetas, com o Apple Intelligence em dispositivos compatíveis
• Faça perguntas sobre a sua coleção e obtenha respostas a partir dos seus próprios dados

PRIVADO POR NATUREZA
• A sua coleção fica nos seus dispositivos e, se quiser, no seu próprio iCloud
• Sem contas, sem anúncios, sem análises. Nada é enviado para nós
• Faça cópias de segurança e restaure toda a coleção como um ficheiro

Atalhos e Siri: registe uma utilização, consulte o custo de um item, pesquise ou adicione um item sem abrir a app. As ligações keeps:// abrem qualquer item.

O feedback abre um e-mail editável com o modelo do dispositivo, a versão do sistema e a versão e o número de compilação do Keeps. Não são anexados registos de diagnóstico nem dados da coleção.

Keeps Pro
O Keeps guarda até 30 itens gratuitamente. O Keeps Pro remove o limite. A importação de compras faz parte do Keeps Pro. Pode rever primeiro o conteúdo de um ficheiro. Tudo o que adicionou continua a ser seu, com ou sem Pro. Comprou o Keeps antes de ser gratuito? O Pro já está incluído.

pt.description:
Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs
- Weapons that can be continuously upgraded
- Cute 2D pixel art
- Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact

※ Warning: You may lose track of time while watching your stats go up!

In the award-winning board game, Le Havre: The Inland Port, you and your opponent compete in order to amass the most wealth by building up the iconic French port of Le Havre. The game can be played locally against the computer, in hot-seat mode or online -- competing against friends or global players in order to advance in the rankings. Drop in and out of play anytime and play an unlimited amount of games with your friends simultaneously, when you want, where you want.

The digital version of the award-winning 2-player board game by cult author Uwe Rosenberg (2013 nominated best for the Golden Geek 2-player board game in 2013, nominated for the International Gamers Award - Strategy Games: 2-player board games and winner of the International Gamers Awards - Strategy Games: 2 player board game).

Use our convenient matchmaking service to challenge players of your skill level globally or play locally with a friend. You can also defeat one of the different computer opponents with varying difficulty. Friend lists and world rankings are included as well.

Reviews:
- Nominated for a Golden Geek: Best Board Game App of 2015

"...set sail with a fantastic licensed port..." - appaddict

"... it’s just plain fun." - gameosity

"It’s refreshing from most games where players just swipe or tap and requires some strategy and savvy to win." - fanboynation

"...grafisch und gameplay-technisch sehr gut gelungen..." - appgefahren

"From the perspective of one who never played the physical board version prior, the game is surprisingly engaging." - androidrundown

"This is a very well done game and fun to play." - appreview central

"If you enjoy this game in its physical form or it’s older brother, Le Havre, then pick up this app." - play-board-games

Features:

- A perfect conversion of the the award-winning board game
- Comprehensive tutorial and straightforward rules
- Drop in and out anytime and save your games in the cloud 
- Beautiful art and sound convey the atmosphere of a French harbor
- Available languages: German, English, French, Spanish
- Worldwide cross-platform leaderboards: Can you take the #1 spot?

For questions and suggestions we are looking forward to your mail:
support@digidiced.com

Visit us on www.digidiced.com

pt.description:
The Loire Valley during the 15th Century. As influential princes, the players devote their efforts to careful trading and building in order to lead their estates to prominence. Two dice set out the action options, but the players always make the final choices. Whether trading or livestock farming, city building or scientific research, many different paths lead to the prosperity and prominence of the players! The many ways to gain victory points in this building game require careful thought round after round along with extensive planning ahead. Thanks to the different estates, the game remains challenging for the players for a long time, as no two games play out alike. The winner is the player with the most victory points at the end of the game.
Features
- The easy to follow tutorial guides you through the rules
- cross-platform play with all opponents
- ranked and casual games
- world ladder with GLICKO rating
- 3 AI opponents (easy, medium and hard)
- play offline alone or with your friends/spouse
- asynchronous game with notifications
- fast ranked games for live experience
- 10 new quality avatars for your DIGIDICED collection
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Chinese (simplified), Japanese, Russian and Italian
- Map Pack DLCs for purchase to add new maps to your game.

pt.description:
You find yourself in rustic, pre-modern Tuscany, where you’ve inherited a meager vineyard. You own a few plots of land, an old crush pad, a tiny cellar, 3 workers…and the dream of owning the best winery in Italy.

Your job is to allocate your workers and helpful visitors to complete various tasks throughout the year. Each season is different on a vineyard, so the workers have different tasks they can take care of in the summer and winter. There’s competition over those tasks, and often the first worker to arrive at each one has an advantage over the rest.

Using those workers and visitors, you can expand your vineyard by building structures, planting vines, and filling wine orders as you work towards the goal of owning the most successful winery in Tuscany.


Features:

• 1 to 6 players
• Family friendly – non violent theme
• Cross Platform
• Easy tutorial to learn the game from scratch.
• Single-player mode with 3 challenging levels of computer opponents.
• Multiplayer games against your friends in friendly games. 
• Face players from all over the world in ranked multiplayer games online!
• Worlwide leaderboard
• Take your time in asynchronous game mode with push notifications and never miss a turn.
• Analyze your best games or learn tricks from the best with playback
• Uses the newest rules of the board game.

O que teria sido do Oeste Selvagem sem seus carismáticos vilões? Uma chatice! pt.description:
CREATE LIFE ON MARS

Lead a corporation and launch ambitious Mars terraforming projects. Direct massive construction works, manage and use your resources, create cities, forests and oceans, and set rewards and objectives to win the game!

In Terraforming Mars, place your cards on the board and use them wisely:
- Achieve a high Terraform Rating, by increasing the temperature and oxygen level or creating oceans... Make the planet habitable for future generations!
- Get Victory Points by building cities, infrastructure and other ambitious projects.
- But watch out! Rival corporations will try to slow you down... That's a nice forest you planted there... It'd be a shame if an asteroid crashed right on it.

Will you be able to lead humanity into a new era? The terraforming race begins now!

Features:
• The official adaptation of Jacob Fryxelius' famous board game.
• Mars for all: Play against the computer or challenge up to 5 players in multiplayer mode, online or offline.
• Game variant: Try the rules of the Corporate Era for a more complex game. With the addition of new cards, including 2 new corporations, focused on economy and technology, you will discover one of the most strategic variants of the game!
• Solo Challenge: Finish terraforming Mars before the end of generation 14. Try new rules and features in the most challenging Solo mode on the (red) planet.

DLCs:
• Speed up your game with the Prelude expansion, adding a new phase at the start of the game to specialize your corporation and boost your early game. It also introduces new cards, corporations and a new solo challenge.
• Explore a new side of Mars with the Hellas & Elysium maps, each bringing a new set of twists, awards and milestones. From the Southern Wilds to the Other Face of Mars, the taming of the Red Planet continues.
• Add the Venus board to your game, with a new Solar phase to hasten your games. Shake up Terraforming Mars with the Morning Star expansion, featuring new cards, corporations, and resources!
• Spice up the game with 7 new cards from the Original Promo Pack: Includes everything from the microbe-oriented corporation Splice to the game-changing Self-Replication Robot project.

* Try the Big Box Promo Pack and its 23 cards to raise the level even higher. Play as the expert-only Pharmacy Union or enjoy the more relaxed Astrodrill corporation with this DLC!
* Establish outposts and trade with them in Colonies! Featuring 49 project cards, 5 corporations, and a whole new game system, Colonies is the most content-packed DLC to date!

Languages available: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Swedish

pt.description:
Aventure-se roubando no premiado jogo de tabuleiro!
Uma nova aventura começa!
"Clank!, o icônico jogo de aventura de tabuleiro de construção de baralho desafia os ladrões ousados a se infiltrarem no covil do dragão, roubar um de seus preciosos artefatos e escapar antes de virar churrasco!

Juntando mais fãs e prêmios ao redor do mundo, Clank! é um dos mais amados jogos de tabuleiro moderno com muitas expansões e adaptações para a diversão dos jogadores."
O quão fundo você irá se aventurar?
"Quanto mais fundo for, mais valiosos serão os tesouros que encontrar... mas será mais difícil ainda escapar! Então seja breve e não faça barulho: Um passo em falso e CLANK! Cada barulho pode chamar a atenção do dragão.

Você está competindo contra seus amigos ladrões para reivindicar o prêmio mais valioso... mas você só terá o saque se conseguir escapar das profundezas com vida!"
Escolha seu caminho
"Você vai precisar de um bom par de botas, uma espada afiada e todas suas habilidades de ladino para sobreviver na masmorra. Ao longo do caminho, você irá adquirir novos itens, perícias e aliados para te ajudar a conquistar a vitória!

Misturando construção de baralho e exploração, Clank! oferece uma aventura de exploração de masmorra única a cada vez que jogar."
Diversas formas de jogar
"Aprenda a usar as cordas no tutorial guia e aprimore suas habilidades ao coletar conquistas e concluir desafios. Jogue em multiplataforma com os amigos ou compita em novos e empolgantes Assaltos que colocam você contra jogadores de todo o mundo!

Seja como for que você entrar na masmorra: boa sorte... você vai precisar!"

pt.description:
New version of the multi-awarded board game. Now in 3D. Includes improved AI, 3D landscape, new exclusive features.

*** Carcassonne fits that opening game niche that every game group needs. -Tyler Nichols, Board Game Quest
*** Carcassonne = Great game, great mechanics, great pieces, great fun! -The Board Game Family

A TILE PLACEMENT GAME OF CREATING LANDSCAPES, CLAIMING AREAS, AND GAINING POINTS
Discover or re-discover Carcassonne, the multi-awarded tile-based game in which players draw and place their tiles to build a medieval city. Place your cities, roads, abbeys or fields to enlarge your landscape, then place your followers, the meeples. Knights, robbers or farmers... Each meeple will help you control your territory and win points.
But be careful, you will need all your best strategy and tactics to maximum your points! Place your tiles and your meeples wisely to stop your opponents and win the game.

6 EXPANSIONS: ENLARGE YOUR LANDSCAPE AND OPTIMIZE YOUR POINTS
Thanks to the mini expansions ""The River"" and ""The Abbot"", you can embellish your landscape and vary your game to enjoy new ways to play! Double or even triple your points thanks to the new buildings in the Inns & Cathedrals expansion! And with the Traders & Builders expansion, score more points with the trading commodities and build faster with the builders! Discover the city of Carcassonne covered with a blanket of white snow in the Winter Edition... and look out for the Gingerbread Man and the bonus points he'll give you! Beware of the Dragon in ""the Princess and the Dragon"" expansion! He could eat your Meeples if you're not cautious. And be kind with the Princess: she might prefer you to other Meeples and toss them out of the cities!

FEATURES
• Accessible and tactical gameplay adapted from the award-winning Carcassonne board game    
• 6 expansions:
- The River, the Inns & Cathedrals, the Traders & Builders, the Winter Edition and Princess & Dragon are all available to purchase from the Game Shop.
- Unlock The Abbot for free using your Asmodee account.
• Up to 6 players! Play against the computer in solo mode, face off your friends in Pass and Play or challenge players from around the world in online mode
• There is no more 3 but 4 different behaviors you can chose before starting a game with AIs. They all propose a better challenge than the previous ones. Players who want to experiment a true challenge will play against the Conqueror AI who is the strongest AI of the game.
• Try out the aerial top view to refine your strategy!
• Additional strategic layers compared to the physical version:
- field view which allows you to see the field possession of each player
- remaining tile list: allows you to see the tiles which are remaining in the draw pile

Languages available: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish
